# Archive decoder fixtures

The RAR files and encryption fixture are decoded byte-for-byte from libarchive v3.8.10's
libarchive/test/*.uu regression corpus. upstream.json records their upstream names and SHA-256.
Source: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/v3.8.10/libarchive/test
The upstream COPYING notice is retained in LIBARCHIVE-LICENSE.txt. Relevant per-file notices
for the test definitions are included below. These small archives test stored/compressed/solid
RAR, old RAR headers, link rejection, encryption rejection and incomplete volumes.

Expected positive-fixture payload SHA-256 values were obtained independently with the installed
7-Zip tool, not copied from this decoder's output. No extracted fixture is ever executed.

layout-mod.7z and unicode-lzma2.7z contain only project-authored test bytes, generated once with
7-Zip/LZMA2. They cover a minimal TES3 master header, variant-folder selection, copy/rename/remove,
and Unicode paths. The generated data is dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0).
Their generation does not add a 7-Zip executable or DLL dependency to the launcher.
